releaseApk.signing: app/android/app/build.gradle signingConfigs.release loads app/android/key.properties and uses storeFile keystoreProperties['storeFile'] ? file(...) : null, and buildTypes.release binds signingConfig signingConfigs.release unconditionally
releaseApk.command: sh scripts/remove_proprietary_dependencies.sh; cd app; flutter pub get; flutter build apk --split-per-abi
releaseApk.note: the upstream release workflow .github/workflows/compile_apk.yml injects secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PROPERTIES and secrets.ANDROID_KEY_STORE. Those are not obtainable, but nothing in the build depends on the upstream identity: a locally generated throwaway keystore plus a locally written key.properties satisfies the same config, so the release APK is buildable with no upstream secret. Also needs a Rust toolchain for app/rust_builder cargokit

applicationPool.reason: Flutter application at every candidate revision: ui/flutter/pubspec.yaml declares name gopeed and the Android module is ui/flutter/android. The product itself is a downloader, so its core flow needs external network transfers, but the two selected defects are settings-page defects that reproduce fully offline. releaseApk.signing: ui/flutter/android/app/build.gradle buildTypes.release chooses signingConfigs.release only when signingConfigs.release.keyPassword is non-null, and falls back to signingConfigs.debug otherwise, so with APK_KEY_PASSWORD and APK_STORE_PASSWORD unset the release APK is debug-signed and installable
releaseApk.command: go install golang.org/x/mobile/cmd/gomobile@latest; gomobile init; gomobile bind -tags nosqlite -o ui/flutter/android/app/libs/libgopeed.aar -target=android -androidapi 21 -javapkg=com.gopeed github.com/GopeedLab/gopeed/bind/mobile; cd ui/flutter; flutter build apk --split-per-abi
releaseApk.note: recipe taken verbatim from .github/workflows/build.yml job build-android. The Go core is linked as a gomobile aar, so the worker needs Go and the Android NDK in addition to Flutter

selectedDefects.issueTitle: bug: Receive Text or Paste are incorrectly identified as link when message starts with URI but has more text after
selectedDefects.whySuitable: the defect is the isLink field of ReceivePageVm in app/lib/pages/receive_page.dart: a message such as https://example.com plus trailing prose satisfied Uri.tryParse().isAbsolute and was rendered as a tappable link instead of plain text. Flutter paints into one SurfaceView, so UiAutomator2 sees no such distinction; reading which branch of the receive page was built means attaching to the Dart isolate over the VM service and inspecting the widget tree and the Riverpod view model. The trigger is an inbound LAN text send, so the adapter has to hold that observation across an incoming HTTP request served by the app's own Dart server
remaining: build affected and fixed profile-mode APKs with Flutter 3.35.6 after running scripts/remove_proprietary_dependencies.sh, with a locally generated throwaway keystore in app/android/key.properties
stand up the second peer: run the repository's own cli/ Dart package on the host and reach the emulator over the LocalSend LAN protocol, or run a second AVD
author the trigger: send the exact message from issue 2904, accept it on the emulator, and read ReceivePageVm.isLink through the Dart VM service
state identity and authority for the observation
minimize the trigger and verify neighboring legal behavior with a bare absolute URL, which must still render as a link on both builds
prove three clean affected reproductions and three reached-observation fixed controls

selectedDefects.issueTitle: Bug report: Client can not download files when using "Share via link" from Android
selectedDefects.whySuitable: SendController set content-length from File(path).lengthSync() even when the selected file was an Android content:// SAF URI, where that call cannot produce a size, so the share-via-link download failed. The fix reads the length through UriContent().getContentLength for content URIs. The trigger runs entirely inside one emulator: pick a file through the Android document picker, start share via link, and issue an HTTP GET from the host through adb forward. The observation is Dart-side, in the app's own HTTP server response, reached over the VM service while the Dart isolate is servicing a native ContentResolver read, which is precisely the Dart-to-platform boundary the Flutter Android adapter has to keep observable
remaining: build affected and fixed profile-mode APKs at the two revisions
seed a file into the emulator's shared storage and drive the Android document picker through UiAutomator2, since the picker is a system UI outside the Flutter surface
wire adb forward from the host to the app's share-via-link port and record the response headers
state identity and authority for the content-length observation
minimize the trigger and verify neighboring legal behavior: a file selected by plain filesystem path must download correctly on both builds
prove three clean affected reproductions and three reached-observation fixed controls

selectedDefects.whySuitable: _pickMedia in app/lib/util/native/file_picker.dart never requested ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION, so Android returned a copy of the picked photo with GPS EXIF stripped. The fix adds a PhotoManager.requestPermissionExtend call with mediaLocation true on the Android branch only. The trigger is a Dart call that crosses a platform channel into an Android runtime permission, and the observation is the bytes of the AssetEntity the Dart side receives back, read over the VM service. It exercises the adapter on an Android-specific path that has no desktop equivalent
remaining: build affected and fixed profile-mode APKs at the two revisions
seed a geotagged JPEG into the emulator MediaStore and confirm the AVD grants ACCESS_MEDIA_LOCATION when asked
drive the in-app media picker and read the returned file's EXIF GPS tags from the Dart side over the VM service
state identity and authority: a picker that claims to return the user's photo must not silently strip its metadata
minimize the trigger and verify neighboring legal behavior: non-location EXIF such as orientation must survive on both builds
prove three clean affected reproductions and three reached-observation fixed controls

selectedDefects.issueTitle: 代理账号、密码无法保存
selectedDefects.whySuitable: the proxy username and password TextEditingControllers in ui/flutter/lib/app/modules/setting/views/setting_view.dart were never wired to the GetX settings controller, so the typed values were dropped and never persisted. The fix adds listeners that copy them into the proxy config and call debounceSave. The trigger is text entry plus an application restart with no network at all, and the check is the persisted Dart-side config object read over the VM service, so it exercises the Flutter adapter's state and lifecycle path on a second, independent application without touching the downloader core
remaining: build the gomobile libgopeed.aar and the affected and fixed profile-mode APKs at the two revisions
author the trigger: enter proxy credentials in the settings page, leave the page, restart the app, and read the persisted config over the VM service
state identity and authority: a setting the application persists must be restored on the next launch
minimize the trigger and verify neighboring legal behavior: the proxy host and port fields on the same page persist on both builds, so the restart itself is not what loses state
prove three clean affected reproductions and three reached-observation fixed controls

selectedDefects.issueTitle: 设置了默认的下载文件夹，结果还是原来的。
selectedDefects.whySuitable: the directory selector assigned controller.text directly and never invoked onEditComplete, so choosing a download directory updated the text field but never reached the saved config. The fix routes every assignment through updateDirectorySelection, which also fires onChanged. On Android the two toggle branches resolve getExternalStorageDirectory and the platform downloads directory, so the trigger is a single tap with no system file picker and no network. The observation is a Dart-side config value after a restart, read over the VM service, which distinguishes it from the sibling gopeed defect: this one is lost at write time, the proxy one at capture time
remaining: build the gomobile libgopeed.aar and the affected and fixed profile-mode APKs at the two revisions
author the trigger: toggle the download directory in settings, restart, and read the persisted directory over the VM service
state identity and authority for the persisted-directory contract
minimize the trigger and verify neighboring legal behavior: a directory typed into the same field by hand persists on both builds
prove three clean affected reproductions and three reached-observation fixed controls

blockers.detail: a Flutter release APK is AOT compiled with the Dart VM service removed, so the declared runtime bound 'Dart VM service' is not reachable from the artifact the release build produces. Both selected applications build a release APK on this host without any upstream signing secret, gopeed by falling back to debug signing and localsend with a locally generated throwaway keystore, but the campaign has to install profile-mode APKs and record explicitly that the observed artifact is the profile build and not the shipped release build
